html:
The Votos, also written Botos or Bostos, were an Indigenous people of the northern plains of Costa Rica, in the San Carlos region near Lake Arenal, at the time of Spanish contact.

Spanish records name them as one of several chiefdoms between the Chorotega of the Pacific side and the Huetar of the central valley. They probably spoke a Chibchan language, perhaps related to that of the Maleku who still live in the area. Little else is known of them.
sum: The Votos, also written Botos or Bostos, were an Indigenous people of the northern plains of Costa Rica, in the San Carlos region near Lake Arenal, at the time of Spanish contact.
